sentences.text: Heard learned Advocate appearing for the applicants.

4. He submits that non-applicant No.2 had filed a private complaint before the learned Judicial Magistrate First Class, Amravati and prayed for investigation under Section 156(3) of the Code of Criminal Procedure.

By an order dated 01.01.2019, the learned Judicial Magistrate Kavita 7-apl 1257-23.odt First Class, Court No.3, Amravati allowed the said prayer and directed the police of City Kotwali, Amravati to investigate.
Thereupon, it appears that the investigation is complete and charge-sheet has also been filed.
At this stage, it appears that the entire charge-sheet has not been filed before this Court.
Learned Advocate for the applicants is directed to file a copy of the entire charge- sheet.

5. It has been vehemently submitted on behalf of the applicants that the contents of the private complaint, which has been then treated as First Information Report under Section 154 of the Code of Criminal Procedure would reflect that the transaction was civil in nature and even in the order it has been reflected by the learned Judicial Magistrate First Class while mentioning the submissions those were made on behalf of the respondent No.2 that though, the dispute was of civil in nature, the police had refused to register the crime.

It can also be seen that the action undertaken by the non- applicant No.2 with the police was inquired into and the police had refused to take cognizance on the ground that the dispute is of civil in nature.
He therefore, submits that there was no element of Section 420 and 406 of the Indian Penal Code involved and therefore, he canvass for quashing of the First Information Report.

6. Taking into consideration the contents of the private complaint and the order that has been passed by the learned Judicial Magistrate First Class, case is made Kavita 7-apl 1257-23.odt out for issuing notice.
7. Issue notice to the respondents.
8. Learned APP waives service of notice for respondent No.1.

9. Notice of respondent No.2 is made returnable on 04.07.2024.
10.
In the meantime, the applicant should produce the entire copy of the charge-sheet and if necessary then leave is granted to carry out the amendment in the petition.
11. In the meantime, there shall be stay to the further proceedings in RCC No.1166 of 2019 pending before the learned Judicial Magistrate First Class, Amravati.
(MRS. VRUSHALI V.JOSHI,J) (SMT.VIBHA KANKANWADI,J) Signed by: Kavita P Tayade
Designation: PA To Honourable Judge Kavita Date: 11/06/2024 18:52:18
